$comment: Vendor provenance of the zen crate set (#3404, D32). vendor/zen was imported byte-identical from the fork tag below with `git subtree add --squash` (updated with `git subtree merge --squash`); import_tree is that tag's git tree. Norn-owned changes since the import are commits in this repository; the first removes the upstream composite action .github/actions/setup-rust/action.yml, which the CI escape-hatch policy rejects and nothing here runs. The crates map is the only admitted zen source: path dependencies at vendor/<path>. The top-level tag must equal fork.tag: .github/workflows/zen-upstream-watch.yml reads it, and that step is frozen in .github/ci/escape-hatch-baseline.json. The vendored crates have no features (#3404): every profile entry is empty, so any feature is outside the Norn profile. Read by norn-skeleton-guard and scripts/zen-dependency-tree.sh.
